about.pageTitle: Connecting Needs With the Right Solutions.
about.paragraph1: NEXORA was created to simplify the way people and businesses find and manage professional services. Instead of spending time searching for the right provider, comparing options, communicating with multiple vendors, and managing the process, customers can simply tell NEXORA what they need.
about.paragraph2: We take care of finding the right connection and coordinating the service from start to finish — so you get one point of contact and one team accountable for the result.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become a trusted connection point for services across the region.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To make finding, coordinating, and delivering professional services simpler, faster, and more reliable.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.description: Tell us what you need and we'll take it from there — or explore how you can join our network of professionals.

what.question: What is NEXORA?
what.answer: NEXORA is a service coordination and business solutions company that connects customers with suitable professionals and service providers.

direct.question: Do you provide the services directly?
direct.answer: NEXORA coordinates services through its network of professionals, companies, freelancers, and service providers.

custom.question: Can I request a service that isn't listed?
custom.answer: Yes. If you don't see the service you need, submit a custom request and tell us what you're looking for.

money.question: How does NEXORA make money?
money.answer: NEXORA earns revenue through service coordination, project management, sourcing, and the margin between the client service price and provider cost.

request.question: How do I request a service?
request.answer: Simply submit the Request a Service form and our team will contact you.

companies.question: Do you work with companies or individuals?
companies.answer: Both. NEXORA serves individuals, startups, small and medium businesses, enterprises, and organizations.

where.question: Where does NEXORA operate?
where.answer: Initially, NEXORA will focus on the UAE and Jordan, with plans to expand across the GCC.

collection.heading: Information We Collect
collection.body: We collect the information you provide when submitting a service request or provider application, such as your name, company, contact details, and project information, as well as basic usage data needed to operate the website.

use.heading: How We Use Information
use.body: We use the information you provide to understand your request, match you with a suitable professional or provider, coordinate the service, and communicate with you about its progress.

sharing.heading: Sharing With Providers
sharing.body: To deliver a requested service, relevant project details may be shared with the professional or company NEXORA coordinates with. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

security.heading: Data Security
security.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect the information you share with us against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us through the details on our Contact page.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using the NEXORA website or submitting a request, you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy.

services.heading: Nature of Our Services
services.body: NEXORA is a service coordination and business solutions company. We identify, coordinate, and manage professionals and providers on your behalf; we are not a marketplace and do not directly perform the underlying services.

responsibilities.heading: Client Responsibilities
responsibilities.body: You agree to provide accurate information about your service request so that NEXORA can match you with a suitable provider and manage the process effectively.

liability.heading: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: While NEXORA coordinates and follows up on quality and delivery, the final service is performed by an independent professional or company. NEXORA's liability is limited to the coordination and management of the engagement.

changes.heading: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: NEXORA may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
